comparison_contract.clock_claim_rule: report cycles plus separately labeled normalized and native time; never silently mix clocks in one speedup
comparison_contract.conversion_cost: zero only for normalized PMA-native ReGraph; native GraSU plus ReGraph must report conversion separately
comparison_contract.full_pagerank: float32 architecture oracle plus independent float64 mathematical oracle, damping 0.85, exactly 3 iterations
comparison_contract.thresholded_residual_pagerank: float32 architecture oracle plus independent float64 mathematical oracle, damping 0.85, epsilon 1e-6, max 256 iterations
comparison_contract.weighted_sssp: uint32 saturating distances, uint16 positive weights, source 0, max 256 rounds

limits.not_claimed: multi-partition weighted SSSP or residual PageRank scalability
limits.reason: current normalized weighted GraSU/ReGraph ABI is one 19-bit destination partition; this corpus deliberately stays in one 65536-vertex compute partition

split_policy.calibration: mechanism parameters may be fitted only from these synthetic fixtures
split_policy.holdout: frozen before fitting and forbidden from parameter selection
split_policy.validation: real compact slices; forbidden from fitting and used for external-shape validation
